message:
Now I understand the fuzz target. It opens an image, reads metadata, and calls `writeMetadata()`. The `writeMetadata()` for a JPEG calls `doWriteMetadata`, which calls `setIptcIrb`.

Let me check if there's a built binary available:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜=command>find /workspace/repo-vul -type f -executable | head -20 && echo "---" && find /workspace/repo-vul -name "*.a" -o -name "*.so" | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
